description: NormalizedIter (lines 600-650) uses a stateful iterator with pending_space flag to normalize in-place without allocating intermediate strings. This is the correct pattern for hot paths in no_std contexts. Unwraps are confined to the non-hot constructor (lines 610, 616) where sentinel values (unwrap_or) are safe. The technique is unforgeable at the type level: the state machine cannot emit double spaces or trailing spaces because the boolean flag makes consecutive space handling deterministic.
title: Decision: Zero-allocation iterator for hot-path normalization
